alt: Poster: 21 Oct 2026 close. Nifty 50 22,811.35 (-0.34%), Nifty Midcap 100 -1.58%, Nifty Smallcap 100 -2.37%; IT the only major gainer
text:
Wednesday's close: the broader market fell harder than the headline indices, with IT the standout gainer.

• Sensex closed at 73,709.69, down 143.21 points (0.19%), and Nifty 50 at 22,811.35, down 77.60 points (0.34%), per Free Press Journal and Times Now.
• Nifty Midcap 100 fell 1.58% and Nifty Smallcap 100 fell 2.37%, per Kotak Neo and Times Now.
• Nifty IT rose more than 2.5%, the only major sector gainer, per Kotak Neo, Free Press Journal and Times Now.
• Brent crude traded above $110 a barrel, with press reports citing Middle East tensions and profit booking after early gains, per Kotak Neo and Free Press Journal.

Our view: a wider fall in mid and small caps than in the index may suggest that risk appetite thinned more at the edges, and elevated crude is one factor markets could be weighing. One session is a small sample, and what follows is uncertain. For long-term investors, it is a reminder that diversified portfolios can see uneven moves across segments. This is an opinion, not a prediction.

For practitioners: when oil-led volatility hits mid and small caps harder, how do you frame the conversation with clients on asset allocation?
